## Automated Tests Required

### [Story Title] — Logic

**Test file path**: per `directory-structure.md` code roots table, e.g. `backend/internal/[context]/app/[use_case]_test.go`

**What to test**:
- [Rule or formula from the spec's Detailed Behaviour — e.g. "proration = remaining_days / period_days * price_delta, rounded half-even in minor units"]
- [Each state transition and permission per role]
- [Each side effect that should / should not occur (event emitted, email queued)]

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Zero / minimum / maximum / boundary input values
- Invalid or null input; unknown enum values
- Concurrent or repeated requests (idempotency)
- [Edge cases from the spec's Edge Cases section]

**Estimated test count**: ~[N] unit tests

---

### [Story Title] — Integration

**Test file path**: `backend/internal/[context]/adapters/[adapter]_integration_test.go` (build tag `integration`) or `src/integrationTest/kotlin/...`

**What to test**:
- [Real PG/Mongo/Redis/Dragonfly behaviour via Testcontainers — constraints, RLS, TTL, eviction]
- [Cache down -> still correct; cache invalidation on write]
- [Outbound provider call against a fake/sandbox with timeout + retry behaviour]

---

## Manual QA Checklist

### [Story Title] — UI

**Verification method**: Retained screenshots of each screen touched
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]/[NN]-[what-it-shows].png`, one per screen
**Matrix**: desktop 1440 + mobile 390; Arabic (RTL) + English; light/dark if supported; empty / loading / error / partial states

- [ ] [Every acceptance criterion translated into a manual check item]
- [ ] Keyboard-only path works; focus visible; labels announced
- [ ] `/impeccable audit` findings addressed

### [Story Title] — Performance

**Verification method**: k6 run against the budget; result saved to `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]/`
**Who must sign off**: performance-engineer

- [ ] p95 within budget at [N] req/s steady and spike
- [ ] No N+1 (query-count assertion green)

---

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off (run via `/smoke-check`):

1. Stack starts and `/readyz` is green (migrations applied)
2. Sign up / log in / token refresh
3. [Primary journey introduced or changed this sprint]
4. [Area with regression risk from this sprint's changes]
5. Tenant isolation spot-check: user in tenant A cannot read tenant B's resource
6. Payment / entitlement path (sandbox) if billing was touched
7. Performance within budget on the staging environment

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — automated test result OR documented evidence
- [ ] The eight DoD gates met or waived in writing in the story file
- [ ] Test files exist for Logic, Integration, Contract and Security stories and pass
- [ ] Load-test evidence vs budget exists for Performance stories
- [ ] Retained screenshots of each screen touched, in `production/qa/evidence/`, for UI stories
- [ ] Run-and-observe evidence (happy and negative path) for every user-visible or callable change
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions — previous sprints' critical journeys still pass
- [ ] Code reviewed (`/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done`

**Stories requiring usability sign-off before close**: [list, or "None"]
